content: Listen to the quiet whisper of the ancient pines; they have watched empires rise and turn to dust.
author: Celtic & Norse Proverbs
sourceWork: Caledonian Forest Lore & Celtic Druidic Precepts
explanation: Humans fret and wage war over borderlines and election cycles that will be completely forgotten in a hundred years. The ancient pine forest stands century after century in majestic stillness, drinking rain and absorbing sunlight. Root your mind in nature's eternal perspective.
practicalInsight: Spend ten minutes near trees or in a park today. Absorb their quiet, unhurried stability.
reflectionPrompt: How can nature's ancient timescale help shrink your immediate daily anxieties into proper proportion?
